 Follow Newlyweds Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes Hope Marriage Will Help Get Them Back on TV: ‘They Really Miss’ It
 Globe Tue, October 20, 2026 at 6:50 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes hope their marriage will improve public perception and open professional opportunities, a source tells Globe, underscoring efforts to reestablish their media roles. The former Good Morning America coanchors, who wed in Arkansas on September 19 per People, were fired in 2022 after their relationship became public during an ABC internal review. The source says they miss mainstream TV and want a show where they can be themselves and work together. They have a podcast and other projects but not at their prior level. They remain in contact with influential industry figures and are eyeing a joint comeback by 2027, if not sooner.
